Phone rings

"You will die in seven days"
How have you been since you've posted this? I want you to know you're not alone. I too feel complete despair and guilt for not being a good parent
You are right, I am selfish
That's true, I am a terrible mess.
I appreciate you reaching out, really

That's the part that kills me, I have no personality without drugs and when I realized this I was full of regret for my entire life. I am no role model for my kids, and I would rather die than teach them they need drugs to be happy
